description: Send a document/file to a WhatsApp number. `file_url` must be a DIRECT url to the file itself. If you generated the file yourself, or it is not already at a direct public url, call upload_file first (it takes the bytes as base64 and returns a url plus the filename to pass here). A Google Drive / Dropbox / OneDrive share link is not a direct url — it points at a download page, and the file arrives as an unopenable "BIN" attachment.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to send this file.

file_url.description: URL of the file to send

filename.description: Display name INCLUDING the extension (e.g. invoice.pdf). WhatsApp shows this name and uses the extension to pick the file type, so a name without one arrives as a generic "BIN" attachment the recipient cannot open. Required whenever file_url has no filename in its path.

phone.description: WhatsApp number in international format without + (e.g. 201234567890), or the contact's phone / chat_id as listed by get_conversations_awaiting_reply (website chat, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram…)

name: send_file
